title: A functional central limit theorem for kernel gradient flow and infinitesimal gradient boosting
summary: Building on the large-sample analysis of infinitesimal gradient boosting (Dombry and Duchamps, 2024), we study the fluctuations of the process around its deterministic limit and establish a functional central limit theorem: the rescaled deviations converge in distribution to a Gaussian process. The analysis is carried out in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) naturally associated with the softmax gradient tree base learner, in which the boosting process is characterized as the solution of an autonomous ordinary differential equation (ODE).
